notes: All costs include 10.25 % tax and the sizing shipping allowance (results.json C0 bom.shipping) plus $15 per added vendor (EST); fees outside the cap excluded (R6).
Rubric scores (controlRisk, scheduleRisk, motor-out cruise points) are engineering judgements (EST) with the evidence quoted per variant.
Non-R1 variants (tiltrotor, tilt-wing, tailsitter) are scored for comparison; R1 is a Given requirement, so they are ranked separately.
Hover-prop cruise efficiency 0.5506 EST (S2 ratio); low-Re dCD0 0.00178 EST; box-wing Di ratio 0.739 (S3).

criteria.name: Cost margin under the $2,000 cap
criteria.anchor: 0 at $0 reserve, 10 at >= $300 reserve (3x the R7 $100 target)
criteria.rationale: R6 is fixed and R7 needs a crash reserve; a student first build usually crashes at least once, so reserve buys a second chance. Feasibility already removes over-cap designs, so this weighs margin only.

criteria.name: Mission energy margin
criteria.anchor: 0 at 10 min (R10 exactly), 10 at 20 min cruise available after 2 min hover and 20 % reserve
criteria.rationale: Drag, prop efficiency and Oswald e are estimates (sizing.mjs EST tags); margin absorbs model error before R10 fails.

criteria.name: MTOW / portability
criteria.anchor: mass part: 10 at 5 kg, 0 at 15 kg; pieces part: 10 at 3 pieces, -2 per extra piece
criteria.rationale: R4/R5: two people carry it, four handle it, <= 15 min assembly. R4 envelope failures are hard flags; this ranks ease within the envelope.

criteria.name: Build complexity (student team, FDM printer, hand tools)
criteria.anchor: index = motors + servos + 3 x tilt axes + 6 x wing pivot + wing panels + boom segments + 2 x special joints; 10 at index 12, 0 at 32
criteria.rationale: R8: four students, printer and hand tools only; every actuator and joint is build, wiring and test time.

criteria.name: Control / transition risk (autopilot maturity)
criteria.anchor: 10 - rubric risk (0 = documented reference path, 10 = no working reference); evidence per variant
criteria.rationale: Transition and hover tuning is where small VTOL projects fail (forum crash reports in configurations.md); R17 asks for maintained support.

criteria.name: Schedule risk to 2027-04-30
criteria.anchor: 10 - rubric risk (redesign scope from the v0.3.1 baseline, new mechanisms, lead time)
criteria.rationale: R8: about 6 months remain; C0 already has CAD, BOM and analysis, so redesign scope is a real cost.

criteria.name: Robustness to motor-out
criteria.anchor: hover motor-out 0–6 (6 if T/W with a pair out >= 1.2) + cruise propulsion-out recovery 0–4
criteria.rationale: R14 (desired) and R15. Weighted below cost/controls because R14 was accepted with hover limits (DESIGN-BASIS R14).

criteria.name: Growth / payload margin
criteria.anchor: kg of extra mass before T/W falls to 1.6 (R13); 10 at >= 3 kg
criteria.rationale: R12 reserves 0.5 kg; mass growth during the build is normal and must not break R13.
